name: building-blog
title_zh: Next.js 项目里长出一套带 Sanity 后台
tagline_zh: 不用再翻五篇教程拼架构。它把 Sanity 数据模型、文章列表页、SEO 元信息一次摆好，你只管填内容。
tagline_en: Stop stitching tutorials. It lays out Sanity schema, list pages, and SEO meta in one pass—you just write.
desc_en: Use when adding a blog to a Next.js + Sanity site, building a blog section from scratch, integrating Sanity CMS for editorial content, or setting up an SEO-optimized article surface. Triggers on phrases like "add a blog", "build the blog", "create blog section", "set up blog with Sanity", "integrate Sanity CMS", "blog architecture", or any new-blog scoping conversation on a Next.js project.
why_zh: 它不生成静态样板，而是按你的 Next.js 版本和路由习惯搭数据流。
why_en: It adapts to your Next.js version and routing style, wiring draft preview and incremental builds into the data flow—not a static.
limit_zh: 只认 Next.js App Router 项目；不含部署配置、Sanity Studio 的视觉定制。
limit_en: App Router only. No deploy setup, Studio theming, comments, or editor choice. Output is a code skeleton—won't resolve your existing style conflicts.
title_en: A Next.js blog skeleton with Sanity CMS built in
